pages.text: Ring Trigger scrolls are engraved onto a $(l:socket-sorcery:socketing/ring)ring$(/l), not a gem. They carry no spell of their own: the ring's socketed engraved gem provides the spell, while this pattern decides when it fires.$(br2)Triggers cannot take modifiers; carve modifiers into the socketed gem instead.

pages.title: Available triggers
pages.text: $(bold)On Hit$() — after taking damage$(br)$(bold)On Attack$() — when you attack$(br)$(bold)On Falling$() — after a dangerous fall$(br)$(bold)On Kill$() — when you slay a foe$(br)$(bold)HP Threshold$() — when health drops low$(br)$(bold)In Radius$() — while a monster is nearby
